definitions.explanation: Free from worries or stress; relaxed and comfortable.
Describes a situation or condition that requires little effort or responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気楽|きらく}だ。
{気楽|きらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}えて→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{気楽|きらく}な⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I've been living a carefree life since retiring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気楽|きらく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It must be nice having an easy position with no responsibility.
examples.notes: Can have a slightly ironic nuance

examples.japanese: {気楽|きらく}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: I thought it was an easy job, but it was actually tough.

examples.japanese: {気楽|きらく}な⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧がしたくて、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I wanted an easygoing trip, so I set out without any plans.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit/mind) + ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ (comfort/ease)
- {気楽|きらく}な + noun - carefree (modifier)
- {気楽|きらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb - in a carefree manner (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気楽|きらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ - to take it easy
- {気楽|きらく}な⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ - carefree life
- {気楽|きらく}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ - easy job
- {気楽|きらく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ - to spend time at ease

USAGE:
Can be positive (relaxed, comfortable) or slightly negative (irresponsible, not taking things seriously).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のんき - carefree, easygoing
- ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ - easy, comfortable
- ⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧ - relaxed
